limitations: Commercial notes (sources/commercial_notes.md) are grounding evidence for semantic judgments but are not modeled as a separate mechanical relation; judgments must cite them in grounding packets where used.
Purpose-layer row inclusion, acquisition-relevance filtering, dependency classification, and identifier rendering transforms are not World relations per KERNEL and intention contract.
invoice_contract_association REJECT disposition (OBL-031) omitted from World IR; vocabulary has no negative disposition and kernel cannot represent closed-world negation.
open_invoice relation declared with manual schema because TaskView.declare_relation cannot assign bare invoice column when invoice_id TEXT role collides on invoice_id column.

admissions.name: invoice_observation
admissions.reason: A billed invoice as represented in authoritative billing with sourced amount, currency, period, and payment status.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Invoice amount, currency, period, status, and billed_name are sourced billing facts; truth does not depend on which diligence question is being asked.

admissions.name: crm_account_observation
admissions.reason: A CRM customer account row with its sourced account name.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: CRM account rows are sourced operational records independent of analytical purpose.

admissions.name: registry_entity_observation
admissions.reason: A company registry row with sourced company number and legal name.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Registry legal names and company numbers are public registration facts, not purpose-relative.

admissions.name: contract_document_observation
admissions.reason: A contract or SOW document header with sourced counterparty text, document type, term dates, and mechanically compiled temporal active flag from explicit expiry or stated term mechanics.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Contract headers, dates, and mechanically compiled active flag describe sourced documents without reference to acquisition or dependency policies.

admissions.name: contract_clause_observation
admissions.reason: A parsed contractual clause kind present in a contract document, independent of any purpose-specific relevance filter.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Parsed clause kinds are present in contract text regardless of whether a purpose treats them as relevant.

admissions.name: account_contract_code_correspondence
admissions.reason: Deterministic correspondence between a CRM account identifier token and a contract filename code token.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Filename token correspondence between CRM IDs and contract stems is a deterministic join rule.

admissions.name: legal_form_mechanical_equivalence
admissions.reason: Exact legal-form variant normalization between two name strings that differ only in permitted corporate suffix or punctuation of the same registered name.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Permitted legal-form suffix normalization is a mechanical string rule, not a purpose threshold.

admissions.name: identity_judgment
admissions.reason: Two referents denote the same legal counterparty, are distinct, or remain unresolved.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Whether two referents denote the same legal entity is a factual identity proposition; purpose B defines which pairs must be linked but the judgment itself is world-eligible.

admissions.name: invoice_contract_association
admissions.reason: An invoice is confidently associated with a governing contract, or the billed-name to contract-counterparty linkage remains unresolved.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Whether an invoice is governed by a contract is a commercial linkage fact; purpose A uses association disposition values but the underlying join is independently meaningful.

admissions.name: commercial_relationship_identity_candidate
admissions.reason: A candidate identity pair required to connect CRM, billing, contract, and registry referents along a commercial relationship span.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Candidate identity pairs along a commercial span are topology facts derived from mechanical correspondence.

admissions.name: open_invoice
admissions.reason: An invoice whose sourced status is open.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Open versus paid invoice status is a sourced billing attribute independent of dependency analysis.

admissions.name: acquisition_relevant_condition_filter
admissions.reason: Purpose A subset of clause kinds that trigger invoice inclusion.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Which clause kinds trigger Purpose A row inclusion depends on the acquisition-exposure analytical question.

admissions.name: purpose_a_qualifying_invoice
admissions.reason: Purpose A output row when active contract bears acquisition-relevant condition.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: An invoice qualifies for Purpose A output only when purpose policies on active contracts and acquisition-relevant clauses are applied.

admissions.name: purpose_a_row_inclusion
admissions.reason: Purpose A policy deciding which invoices appear in purpose_ir/a/output.json.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Including an invoice in Purpose A output is a purpose decision, not a world fact.

admissions.name: purpose_b_required_link_set
admissions.reason: Purpose B topology defining required CRM–billing–contract–registry links.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: The set of identity links Purpose B must emit is defined by commercial-diligence topology policy.

admissions.name: purpose_c_dependency_classification
admissions.reason: Purpose C dependent versus unresolved status over two-part dependency test.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Commercial dependency (dependent versus unresolved) is a composite purpose analytical construct.

admissions.name: purpose_c_current_relationship_test
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Whether an open invoice or rolling-term contract satisfies prong 1 depends on Purpose C policy thresholds.

admissions.name: identifier_rendering_transform
admissions.reason: Purpose output identifier stripping (invoice/contract prefix removal).
admissions.purpose_independence_test: Stripping referent prefixes for purpose output rendering is a presentation transform, not world truth.
